question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Diligent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Inactive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Diligent"** means showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a diligent student who spends hours studying for her exams.
 
 
 
• **"Inactive"** refers to someone or something that is not engaging in any activity or is idle. (निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** Due to illness, he became inactive and spent most of his time resting.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Diligent"** is **"Inactive"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Inactive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Industrious** (मेहनती): Hardworking and diligent in nature.

 
 
• **Example:** He is known for being industrious and committed to his job.
 
 
 
• **Hardworking** (परिश्रमी): Putting a lot of effort and care into work.
 
 
• **Example:** The hardworking farmer toils day and night in the fields.
 
 
 
• **Persistent** (दृढ़): Continuing firmly in a course of action despite difficulties.
 
 
• **Example:** Her persistent efforts finally led to success in the project.
